## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle late-Míng commentary on the *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn* sūtra ([KR6k0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0073)) by **Yǒng Hǎi** 永海 ([永海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B0%B8%E6%B5%B7)). Companion to [性祇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%80%A7%E7%A5%87) Xìng Qí's *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn jīng lüèjiě* ([KR6k0074](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0074)).

**Abstract**

Yǒng Hǎi's commentary, like its companion by Xìng Qí, reflects the late-Míng Vinaya revival's interest in casuistic disciplinary literature. Where Xìng Qí's *lüèjiě* tends to abridge, Yǒng Hǎi's *jīngshì* tends to expand and contextualise the Buddha's adjudications, providing more discussion of doctrinal background and historical precedent. The two are typically read together.
